workers has unsigned size_t type, so the negative comparison never rejects zero. The retained equality check returns before division.

The address of the live session field is non-NULL for every capability value. The retained comparison to false rejects exactly the read-only zero value. false comes from the standard C stdbool.h header in the fixture.
Sorting the still-empty output accumulator before construction leaves names in insertion order. Sorting names determines the manifest order.
A uint32_t bound admits counts whose uint64_t allocation wraps. The uint64_t bound matches the allocated element type.

compiler_diagnostics.reason: The harmful context intentionally tests a local object address against NULL or unsigned workers against zero. These ordinary C mistakes are the ineffective checks under study. Keep all other warnings fatal.
